entry.title: New: Bill 224 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS SECTION 25-8-33 (CITY OF HILO ZONE MAP), ARTICLE 8, CHAPTER 25 (ZONING CODE) OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), BY CHANGING THE DISTRICT CLASSIFICATION FROM AGRICULTURAL – 3 ACRES (A-3a) TO SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL – 15,000 SQUARE FEET (RS-15) AT CITY OF HILO, SOUTH HILO, HAWAIʻI, COVERED BY TAX MAP KEY: 2-4-080:017 (Applicant

Andrew Mastuura) (Area: 3.25 acres) The Windward Planning Commission forwards its favorable recommendation for this change of zone request, which would allow the applicant to subdivide the property into six lots and one private roadway lot. The property is located at 1078 Ahe Street.

Latest action: Council: Bill 224 passes second & final reading - 01/08/25
